in_sanskrit.name: प्रसाद
in_sanskrit.meaning: प्रसाद: प्रसादः स प्रसादः प्रसन्नताम् विहग्नो विद्धि । प्रसादः स प्रसन्नः स विधाता विधत्ते ।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Prasad: Prasadah sas Prasanatam Vihagnah Vidhhi. Prasadah sas Prasannah sas Vidhata Vidhatti. (Sanskrit prayer: May the propitious Vihaga (Agni) bless us with the graceful Prasad.)

in_hindi.name: प्रसद
in_hindi.meaning: प्रसाद: प्रसाद के समान विधान, स्वतंत्र विधान, स्वतंत्र प्रसाद

in_marathi.name: Prasad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessing, Prasadam, or Merit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A blessing, offering, or merit. In Hinduism, a Prasadam is a religious offering, often in the form of food, that is given to the deity during puja and then distributed to the devotees as a blessing. This name is also given to a child born as a blessing or as a result of a prayer.

vedic_reference.note: Prasad is a term used in Hinduism and Buddhism to denote an offering or a blessing. In Hinduism, Prasad is offered to various deities during puja (worship) and is considered sacred. In Buddhism, Prasad is offered to Buddha or other deities and is believed to bring blessings and good fortune.
